items.text: The NIFTY 500 rose 0.3% on 26 Nov. Capital Goods was the strongest sector (+0.8%) and Construction the weakest (−0.3%).

FIIs bought a net ₹4,479 Cr and DIIs bought a net ₹4,019 Cr of Indian shares on 25 Nov. Foreign investors are quietly accumulating in 73 niches; Commodity API, Electricals, Lighting & Electronics and Small PSU Banks and others joined today. Heavy delivery buying this week in Travel Services & Railways Catering, Luggage & Bags and Large Private Banks.
